history.prompt: Generate a NEW unlabeled PNG background for a Chinese machine learning textbook. External reference images supplied are scientific mechanism references, NOT an edit target; invent your own readable composition and do not copy a reference layout. Style: crisp minimalist flat 2D technical diagram; transparent canvas where no diagram content, to be composited on exact pure white. ALL individual fills uniform opaque solid color; white and very pale Green #67A583, Blue #7B95C6, Peach #FFC1A6, Rose #C85E62 mixed with white. Neutral wires #4C4D4F. Sparse meaningful planar mechanism glyphs, no decorative card/icon sets. White modules and colored outlines, very restrained pale grouping only if needed. No perspective, 3D, extrusion, shadows, highlights, gradients, paper texture, grain, waves, stripes or uneven blotchy fills. No letters, digits, text, formulas, plus signs, pseudo writing or watermark anywhere; circular operators should be empty for subsequent font typesetting. Reserve clearly sized blank spaces inside operations for 2–5 Chinese-character names, and adjacent to all input/output wires for variables. Avoid huge border enclosing all computation. Aim landscape, readable at textbook figure width. Mechanism: GRU using convention new hidden = update gate times old hidden + complement of update gate times candidate. Current input and old hidden combine and split to exactly TWO sigmoid gate modules (reset and update) and candidate tanh. Reset gate multiplies old hidden ONLY within candidate construction, then current input enters candidate. A separate old hidden bypass is multiplied by update gate. Update gate also passes a single small complement module, then multiplies candidate. These two weighted branches add to new hidden, then task readout prediction. Exactly three multiply circles and one add circle, all empty; complement module empty. Show vectors and clear bypass paths. Reserve room to type same-line variable alongside module title. No leaked new hidden into its own gate calculation.
